'''DarthVader Han visits Kashyyyk... please join him! The Kashyyyk Controller Deck''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[DarthVader]]
* '''Published:''' 22 August 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Local Uprising / Liberation|SE-L-localuprising.gif|label=Local Uprising}}
* '''Strategy:''' Local Uprising
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 LU DarthVader LS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Use squadron assignments for pulling the character, virtual sai'tor kal fas for pulling the weapon, and your insight for pulling the superficial damage (if needed). Most of the stuff in this deck deploys really cheap, and I mean cheap!

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

My strategy is versatility, high destiny, and lots of forfeit to soak up damage. If the opponent controls the ground, I go into space (or vice versa). Battle Plan works great with this too! A neat little trick I've found is that Rallitir Freighter Captains deploy free to Kashyyyk and can get the bonus' of Insertion Planning to hold the ground early in the game. Melas is one of the most recent finds I've had for this deck. Any suggestion is welcome, but goe easy on me I'm not a tournament caliber player.
